        return 0

    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return False
    cpu_util = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_util = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    return cpu_util > 0.7 or mem_util > 0.8

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request > node.cpu_capacity:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000.0

    weighted_latency = 0.0
    total_rate = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node] * rate
                total_rate += rate

    avg_latency = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        avg_latency = weighted_latency / total_rate

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_util = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_util = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)

    cpu_frac = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    marginal_power = (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * cpu_frac
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0:
        marginal_power += node.power_idle_w

    queue_penalty = 0.0
    if cpu_util > 0.75:
        queue_penalty = (cpu_util - 0.75) * 200.0
    mem_queue = 0.0
    if mem_util > 0.85:
        mem_queue = (mem_util - 0.85) * 100.0

    headroom = resource_headroom(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity) + resource_headroom(mem_after, node.mem_capacity)
    headroom_bonus = float(headroom) * 0.25

    active_bonus = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated > 0:
        active_bonus = 25.0

    suspend_penalty = 0.0
    if node.suspended:
        suspend_penalty = 200.0

    capacity_bonus = float(node.cpu_capacity) * 0.001
    energy_penalty = marginal_power * 0.1
    latency_penalty = avg_latency * 2.0

        return -1000000.0

        return -1000000.0

    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request

        return -1000000.0

    for edge in range(len(graph.src)):
        source = graph.src[edge]
        destination = graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1

            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = state.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node] * rate
                total_rate += rate

    avg_latency = 0.0

    cpu_frac = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    marginal_power = (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * cpu_frac
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0:
        marginal_power += node.power_idle_w

    queue_penalty = 0.0
    if cpu_util > 0.7:
        queue_penalty = (cpu_util - 0.7) * 200.0
    mem_queue = 0.0

        mem_queue = (mem_util - 0.8) * 100.0

    headroom_bonus = float(headroom) * 0.25

    capacity_bonus = float(node.cpu_capacity) * 0.001

    latency_penalty = avg_latency * 2.0

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:

        return out
    moves_made = 0
    for i in range(len(state.pods)):
        if moves_made >= budget:
            return out
        pod = state.pods[i]
        eligible = pod.stateful == False and pod.has_pdb == False and pod.current_node >= 0

# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays

#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the

# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def resource_headroom(used: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity <= 0:
        return 0
    free = capacity - used
    if free <= 0:
        return 0
    return (free * 100) // capacity

def node_is_hot(node: NodeState) -> bool:
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return False
    cpu_util = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_util = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    return cpu_util > 0.7 or mem_util > 0.8

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request > node.cpu_capacity:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000.0

    weighted_latency = 0.0
    total_rate = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node] * rate
                total_rate += rate

    avg_latency = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        avg_latency = weighted_latency / total_rate

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_util = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_util = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)

    cpu_frac = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    marginal_power = (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * cpu_frac
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0:
        marginal_power += node.power_idle_w

    queue_penalty = 0.0
    if cpu_util > 0.75:
        queue_penalty = (cpu_util - 0.75) * 200.0
    mem_queue = 0.0
    if mem_util > 0.85:
        mem_queue = (mem_util - 0.85) * 100.0

    headroom = resource_headroom(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity) + resource_headroom(mem_after, node.mem_capacity)
    headroom_bonus = float(headroom) * 0.25

    active_bonus = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated > 0:
        active_bonus = 25.0

    suspend_penalty = 0.0
    if node.suspended:
        suspend_penalty = 200.0

    capacity_bonus = float(node.cpu_capacity) * 0.001
    energy_penalty = marginal_power * 0.1
    latency_penalty = avg_latency * 2.0

    return headroom_bonus + active_bonus + capacity_bonus - energy_penalty - latency_penalty - queue_penalty - mem_queue - suspend_penalty

def move_score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx) -> float:
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request > node.cpu_capacity:
        return -1000000.0
    if node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000.0

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_util = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_util = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    if cpu_util > 0.85 or mem_util > 0.9:
        return -1000000.0

    weighted_latency = 0.0
    total_rate = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(graph.src)):
        source = graph.src[edge]
        destination = graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = state.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node] * rate
                total_rate += rate

    avg_latency = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        avg_latency = weighted_latency / total_rate

    cpu_frac = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    marginal_power = (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * cpu_frac
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0:
        marginal_power += node.power_idle_w

    queue_penalty = 0.0
    if cpu_util > 0.7:
        queue_penalty = (cpu_util - 0.7) * 200.0
    mem_queue = 0.0
    if mem_util > 0.8:
        mem_queue = (mem_util - 0.8) * 100.0

    headroom = resource_headroom(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity) + resource_headroom(mem_after, node.mem_capacity)
    headroom_bonus = float(headroom) * 0.25

    active_bonus = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated > 0:
        active_bonus = 25.0

    capacity_bonus = float(node.cpu_capacity) * 0.001
    energy_penalty = marginal_power * 0.1
    latency_penalty = avg_latency * 2.0

    return headroom_bonus + active_bonus + capacity_bonus - energy_penalty - latency_penalty - queue_penalty - mem_queue

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moves_made = 0
    for i in range(len(state.pods)):
        if moves_made >= budget:
            return out
        pod = state.pods[i]
        eligible = pod.stateful == False and pod.has_pdb == False and pod.current_node >= 0
        if eligible:
            current_node = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
            hot = node_is_hot(current_node)
            if hot:
                current_score = move_score(pod, current_node, state, graph)
                best_score = current_score + 5.0
                best_node = -1
                for j in range(len(state.nodes)):
                    if j != pod.current_node:
                        candidate = state.nodes[j]
                        candidate_score = move_score(pod, candidate, state, graph)
                        if candidate_score > best_score:
                            best_score = candidate_score
                            best_node = j
                if best_node >= 0:
                    out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best_node))
                    moves_made += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    return -total

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    m = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        if moved < budget and graph.rate[e] > 1.0:
            sp = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
            dp = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
            placed = sp.current_node >= 0 and dp.current_node >= 0
            if placed and sp.current_node != dp.current_node:
                if not sp.stateful and not sp.has_pdb:
                    dest = state.nodes[dp.current_node]
                    if not dest.suspended:
                        out.append(move_pod(sp.id, dp.current_node))
                        moved += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
